comparison.objective: Zero a robot joint by holding alignment and inserting a calibration pin, versus collet-nut preassembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a large link on a mark while axially inserting a pin; candidate uses small-part marked groove capture and non-axial tilt-roll motion.
comparison.success_condition: Joint and mark must align with the calibration pin seated; candidate requires retained collet after release and pull check. Candidate numeric insertion limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Marked alignment is generic; axial pinning does not test eccentric snap engagement.
